input: Ask neighbors to form a street emergency plan

gold.taskTitle: Organize a Street Emergency Plan with Neighbors
gold.taskDescription: Coordinate with neighbors to create a shared emergency preparedness plan for the street or neighborhood.

questions.title: How many households are on your street?
questions.description: Understanding the scale helps determine how to organize outreach and meetings.

questions.title: What type of emergency are you mainly planning for?
questions.description: Knowing the specific threat — fire, flood, earthquake, power outage — shapes the plan's priorities.

questions.title: Have any neighbors already expressed interest in this?
questions.description: Identifies whether there is an existing base of support or if outreach starts from scratch.

questions.title: Do you want a formal meeting or casual door-to-door approach?
questions.description: The preferred outreach style affects how invitations and conversations are structured.

questions.title: Is there a deadline or urgency driving this plan?
questions.description: A recent event or upcoming season may set a timeline for completing the plan.

questions.title: Are there any vulnerable residents who need special consideration?
questions.description: Elderly, disabled, or households without vehicles may need specific roles or accommodations in the plan.

questions.title: What role do you want to play in leading this effort?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the user wants to be the main organizer or share leadership with others.
